description: The most challenging part—beyond just extracting information from space—is getting it into the hands of small-scale rural producers in a way that is both understandable and accessible; and that is exactly what we do with PersonalAgro!!
summary: A parte mais desafiadora – além de apenas extrair informações do espaço – é colocá-la nas mãos de produtores rurais de pequena escala de uma maneira compreensível e acessível; e é exatamente isso que fazemos com a PersonalAgro!
details:
In Brazil, 80% of small-scale farmers lack access to technical assistance, and many are illiterate. With Personal Agro, they simply need to send their location and a voice message via WhatsApp. We cross-reference data and maps from NASA with information from EMBRAPA (the Brazilian Agricultural Research Corporation) to plan intelligent crop rotation and provide guidance on sustainable farming practices. Our solution aims to make a positive impact on the economy, the food supply, and the environment by providing small-scale producers with a user-friendly tool tailored to their specific needs. Existing solutions were not designed for small-scale farmers, who often lack digital literacy, infrastructure, and capital.

Personal Agro: NASA science, delivered through the voice of the small-scale farmer.
